list.name: device_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM telemetry_metrics ORDER BY device_id

list.name: interface
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT interface_name
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND interface_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY interface_name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  metric_value AS "RX",
  device_id AS device,
  interface_name AS interface
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'bandwidth_in'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND interface_name IN (${interface:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  metric_value AS "TX",
  device_id AS device,
  interface_name AS interface
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'bandwidth_out'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND interface_name IN (${interface:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  metric_value AS "RX util %",
  device_id AS device,
  interface_name AS interface
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'utilization_in'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND interface_name IN (${interface:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  metric_value AS "TX util %",
  device_id AS device,
  interface_name AS interface
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'utilization_out'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND interface_name IN (${interface:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Bandwidth-Consuming Interfaces (last 15 min, avg RX bps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_id || '/' || interface_name AS metric, AVG(metric_value) AS value FROM telemetry_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'bandwidth_in' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY device_id, interface_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
